contracts: Boundary/diff inspection plus temporary integration assertions prove same existing sole authorities, build metadata, stable IDs/history, snapshot hashes and restored content. Integration success alone certifies neither Windows Runner/ACL nor cross-host behavior.
selector_intents: The selected Python function must contain literal subprocess.run(["dotnet", "test", "PhaseA.Platform.Tests/PhaseA.Platform.Tests.csproj", "--filter", "FullyQualifiedName=PhaseA.Platform.Tests.NodeIdentity.NodePersistenceTests.test_existing_foundation_extended_without_second_authority", "--logger", "trx"], shell=False, ...), use a fresh isolated TestResults directory, verify the new TRX names this exact executed test and its assertions, and reject stale, skipped, zero-test, binding, setup, compile or restore failures as business observations. Fail this constraint on actual boundary/diff finding of unnecessary replacement or competing authoritative writer/store/recovery path, independently of retained-data assertions. Use real existing schema/store/storage/restore public calls rather than method-presence or missing-helper checks. No new validation infrastructure, persistence authority or live metadata fixtures.
